prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop landing-page direction comp, 1440×900 landscape
Primary request: Render the edge-to-edge first viewport for “Quản Lý Dạy Thêm”, a Vietnamese multi-center tutoring operations product. A center owner, administrator or teacher must immediately understand the continuous operating flow from center approval and role assignment to class scheduling and attendance, then be able to sign in.
Text (verbatim): “Quản Lý Dạy Thêm”; “Ngày dạy bắt đầu từ một nhịp rõ ràng”; “Tên đăng nhập”; “Mật khẩu”; “Đăng nhập”; “Quên mật khẩu?”; milestones “Mở lớp”, “Xếp lịch”, “Điểm danh”, “Chốt phiên”.
Composition: make one continuous day strip fill the entire viewport like a modern teaching planner and timetable, not a generic split hero. The sign-in form is the first pinned action on the strip; subsequent time blocks reveal the four milestones, real room and class snippets, and a quiet lower continuation proving the visual system can govern the product. Include a compact mark, minimal navigation “Tổng quan · Vận hành · Bảo mật”, and a small live-status utility at the far edge.
Visual law: cool white ruled pages are the ground; navy carries typography and structure; jade marks active and verified work; apricot marks upcoming work; vermilion marks exceptions. Use a sturdy Vietnamese-friendly grotesk, bold day tabs, visible ruling, clipped annotations, and a single animated-looking progress stroke connecting actions. Keep it calm, colorful, highly legible and operational.
Constraints: crisp readable Vietnamese, functional website interface, no browser chrome, no device mockup, no stock-photo people, no floating glass cards, no generic blue SaaS gradient, no watermark.
